in_hebrew.name: יִגְעַים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יִגְעַים (yig'āyim) comes from the Hebrew verb גָּעַ (gā'a) which means 'to reward'. The name Giaimo in Hebrew is יִגְעַים (yig'āyim), meaning 'God is my reward'.

in_greek.name: Γειάμων
in_greek.long_meaning: Γειάμων (Geiamōn) is derived from the Greek word γειαμα (geiama), which means 'gracious' or 'kind'. The name Giaimo in Greek is Γειάμων (Geiamōn).

in_latin.name: Iacobus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Giaimo in Latin is Iacobus, which comes from the Hebrew name יַעֲקֹב (ya'aqov), meaning 'he who supplants' or 'grasps the heel'. This Latin form of the name is not directly related to the meanings of 'God is gracious' or 'God is my reward', but it is a common transliteration of the Hebrew name in the Latin Bible.
